title: Our Place Is Frying Up a Spicy Sale, Including My Favorite Pan
gist: Promotional Wired deals post: Our Place kitchenware is 15-30% off via Shop with an extra $60 off $100+ orders, highlighting the Always Pan 2.0 at $95 and the Wonder Oven Pro at $275.

insights.claim: Shop is offering 15 to 30 percent off Our Place kitchenware plus an extra $60 off orders of $100 or more, ahead of Black Friday.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Pre-Black Friday discounting by DTC kitchenware brands, distributed through Shop.

insights.claim: Our Place's Always Pan 2.0 is discounted from $135 to $95 (30% off); Wired's reviewer calls it her most-used pan though its nonstick coating stains a bit.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Hero-product discounting depth hints at promotional intensity in premium cookware.
insights.locator: The Our Place Always Pan is my number-one

insights.claim: Our Place's Wonder Oven Pro countertop multi-cooker is $275, down 15% from $325; the reviewer is considering replacing her microwave with it.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Our Place is extending from cookware into countertop appliances.
insights.locator: I just started testing the Wonder Oven Pro
